name: Rossler Attractor
desc: The Rossler attractor integrated tens of thousands of steps per frame into a self-rotating fading density buffer, its single-scroll spiral stretching and folding into a Mobius ribbon that glows deep-blue in-plane and hot-orange at the fold, rendered as spiral-fold, iridescent plasma, molten ember, cryo ice, or a graphite pencil study.

density.doc: integration steps per frame (38k..72k) — more = denser, brighter ribbon

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude of the density field

fold.doc: c parameter — higher sharpens the chaotic fold
